name: Tranco research-oriented top-sites ranking (daily top-1M list)
operator: Tranco research project (DistriNet, KU Leuven, with TU Delft and Grenoble INP authors)
tier_rationale: Academic research project with a peer-reviewed methodology (Le Pochat et al., NDSS 2019), identifiable university operators and public documentation (A8 trusted: established academic institutions). 'Tranco is an academic project: tier trusted, terms open' (P010 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Popularity aggregate of five providers (CrUX, Farsight, Majestic, Radar, Umbrella) over 30 days, hardened against manipulation; popularity is never evidence of benignness (P010 cond 3: a dampener only, never an allow-list).

top1m.title: Tranco daily top-1M list (top-1m.csv.zip: rank,domain; registrable domains only)

terms.quote: Free; cite Le Pochat et al. (NDSS 2019)

top1m.notes: Research C0042 terms 'Free; cite Le Pochat et al. (NDSS 2019)'. Fetched only by `v3lum data update tranco_rank.top1m` (9.7 MB zip, 22.7 MB expanded: never during a scan, A6/AR10), extracted with the core safe_extract and indexed on disk (SQLite) at refresh time; lookups never load the list into memory (P010 cond 1). No ranks-API fallback is ever built: a missing list is UNAVAILABLE 'dataset' (P010 cond 2). https://tranco-list.eu/top-1m.csv.zip answers a relative 307 to /download/daily/top-1m.csv.zip on the same host (observed 2026-11-26).

list_id.title: Tranco id of the latest daily list (GET /top-1m-id, e.g. 947P2): provenance of the downloaded list

terms.quote: Free; cite Le Pochat et al. (NDSS 2019)

list_id.notes: A 5-byte text answer refreshed together with the list by `v3lum data update` (fetched right after the zip: datasets update in name order), so findings and evidence cite the list id and date (P010 cond 2). The id-addressed list page https://tranco-list.eu/list/<id> is the reference Tranco asks users to cite.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-2 (P010, module tranco_rank). Dataset-only provider: tranco_rank has disclosure 'none' and never sends an investigated value anywhere; only `v3lum data update` contacts tranco-list.eu (2 requests per refresh). The Le Pochat et al. NDSS 2019 citation is the dataset attribution (v3lum/data/notices/tranco.json, report footer when Tranco data is used, P010 cond 7).
